contracts: dialog.loc is optional: native 004D69B0 returns immediately when fopen(rb) fails; no file creation or replacement asset is required.
120 entries: three node pointers plus DWORD initialized flag, not four pointers. A node has six file DWORDs and next pointer at +24, size28.

Node reads preserve six separate fread(4,1) calls; error0x20 preserves an existing head; EOF/error0x30 rejects/frees only the new node. Outer failing entry drops three heads without freeing older nodes, as native.
UI text adapters initialize layout lazily, subtract origins for lookup, apply real overrides/highlight and call complete native bitmap owners. Current-text/reset/glyph aliases must be shared.
Status controller preserves tomb/active/timing precedence, signed wrapping calendar arithmetic, four shadows, exact English debug strings, event cursor restoration and paused panel.
Button border uses signed truncate-divide plus nonzero remainder, including negative dimensions; style is unused, flags!=0 selects base+8, scratch coordinates update even for skipped interior tiles.

Panel 536820/536A30 retain the shared sprite-pattern core but write native scratch X, scratch Y and image/glyph DWORD before each real draw, in instruction order. Live image base is reloaded per tile.
reuse: Current C text selector, font renderers, layout key/find/highlight, panel and image draw owners reused. Old generated/mixed source and numbered Unit01837/01860/01861/02449 were searched; Original-based bodies were not counted as complete C.
stdio_boundary: Concrete provider performs real _fsopen with native share0x40 (_SH_DENYNO), fread/feof/ferror/fclose/malloc/free. It does not reconstruct native CRT FILE layout, allocator/errno globals or resource-failure ABI; original CRT entrypoints remain unmapped.
limits: Native-valid streams must initialize the count and allocations must succeed. A first truncated count has native stack-dependent data; this is not invented as a C API input.
No native/C replay, rendered-pixel comparison or full menu-to-gameplay equivalence claim.
Host attachment still needs the actual shared text/input state, fonts, button records and mission/status fields; the runtime still accepts only the documented Nubt subset.
ghidra: Eleven native names and stack prototypes applied; native panel store/loop instructions retained. Node/entry layouts annotated. Bridge rejects inline structure creation; new named Ghidra structures remain pending.
